leadText:
An Earl (Japanese: アール Earl) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in Generation VI. This Trainer class is a title of nobility, granted in the Battle Chateau, and Trainers with this class only appear there. Earl is the third rank of nobility for males, ranking above and below . Its counterpart for females is .

The male player character may earn the title of Earl by winning enough s in the Battle Chateau. All opponent Earls use parties of two Pokémon at level 25 (if no Writ of Challenge is active).
